cards.text: Jesus has just finished telling a whole run of parables. Now He leaves that place and comes to His hometown, where He teaches the people in their synagogue. And friend, a hometown crowd is a WHOLE different kind of crowd.
The people listening are astonished. You know when somebody you've known forever suddenly says something brilliant, and your first thought isn't "wow," it's "wait, since WHEN?"

cards.question: Listening to Jesus in the synagogue, what are the hometown people asking?

answers.text: Where His wisdom and powers came from
When He will heal the sick in town
How long He plans to stay in town

cards.text: Then they start listing what they already know about Him: "Isn't this the carpenter's son?" They name His mother, Mary, and His brothers, James, Joseph, Simon and Judas, like they're flipping through His family photo album OUT LOUD.

cards.question: The hometown crowd says all of Jesus's sisters are with them as well.

cards.text: And after all that, they land right back where they started: "Where then did this man get all these things?" They know His mother, His brothers, His sisters, and they STILL can't figure out where it came from.

cards.question: After all their questions, the hometown crowd honors Jesus.

cards.text: They take offense at Him. Jesus answers them with one short line about a prophet and honor, and friend, that one line LANDS.

cards.question: According to Jesus, where is a prophet without honor?

answers.text: Only in his hometown and his own household
Only in big cities and royal courts

cards.question: Jesus did not do many ___ in His hometown, because of their ___.
